author: badgg
body:
Hello everyone,
The Map Development team is happy to announce that we have decided to replace the current hub with a fresh one!
Why may you ask? We felt that with the current one; was too difficult to customize and add 'themes' such as Christmas what-not.
Additionally, our goal with this new lobby was to add flexibility on an interaction level. Meaning, the new hub has a "sandbox" region, MANY more secrets (each map developer created their own), better parkour and more! To add on, the size of the hub is reasonable. It's quite small compared to the previous hubs, so it's easy to navigate!



Thanks for reading, and I hope you enjoy this new lobby!
Many thanks,
Map Development team.
